claim.claim: The acquisition activity Netflix disclosed as of September 30, 2026 has no material effect on its financial position.

verdict.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
verdict.reasoning_summary:
The claim states that acquisition activity Netflix disclosed as of September 30, 2026 has no material effect on its financial position. This is a qualitative/interpretive claim about the materiality of acquisition activity.

I searched through all the provided evidence passages from Netflix's Q3 2026 10-Q filing (filed 2026-10-21 for period ending 2026-09-30) and Q2 2026 10-Q filing. None of the evidence passages contain any information about acquisitions or acquisition activity. The evidence includes:
- E1: Internal controls and legal proceedings
- E2: Stock repurchases and risk factors
- E3: Revenue by geographic segment for Q3 2026 vs Q3 2025
- E4: Revenue details including hedging impacts
- E5: Internal controls from Q2 2026 filing
- E6: Interest and other income/expense

Without any evidence discussing acquisition activity disclosed as of September 30, 2026, I cannot verify whether such activity exists or assess its materiality to Netflix's financial position. The evidence is insufficient to support or contradict the claim.
